entries.title: The Pantheon
paragraphs: Long ago, Heaven appointed a pantheon to keep the world in order. Each god was given a duty, and each duty was given servants to carry it out.
For an age the order held. The gods kept their charges, and the creatures who served them kept their posts.

entries.title: The Corruption
paragraphs: A villain reached the pantheon and corrupted it from within. The gods did not fall silent. They kept working, but the commands they followed were twisted.
The corrupted do not know what has been done to them. They still believe they serve, and their servants still defend them.

entries.title: The Lesser Angel
paragraphs: Heaven did not send an army. It sent a lesser angel to walk among the fallen gods.
The angel carries no great rank and no crown of light, only the skills it has learned and the task it has been given.

entries.title: Release, Not Ruin
paragraphs: The angel was not sent to destroy the gods, but to set them free.
Every battle is fought to break the corruption's hold. When it breaks, the old duty is no longer twisted, and what Heaven once appointed is released.

entries.title: The Five Schools
paragraphs: The angel's techniques come from five schools: Guardian Arts, Astral Magic, Corrupted Alchemy, Ruin Survival and Forbidden Rituals.
Some were taught by those who once kept the threshold. Some were learned from starlight, from the ruins, or from the corruption itself. A few are dangerous, and are used only when safer means fail.
